passphrase.body: Yi amfani da aƙalla haruffa {{min}}. Gajeriyar jumla da kai kaɗai ka sani tana da kyau. Ba za mu iya sake saita ta maka ba.
passphrase.mismatch: Kalmomin sirrin ba su yi daidai ba.

recovery.title: Lambar dawo da bayananka
recovery.body: Waɗannan kalmomi {{total}} su ne maɓalli na biyu na littattafanka na sirri. Rubuta su a takarda ka ajiye su a wuri mai aminci.
recovery.onlyOnce: Ana nuna wannan lamba sau ɗaya kawai. Ba za mu iya sake nuna ta ko dawo maka da ita ba.

recoveryEntry.label: Lambar dawowa
recoveryEntry.placeholder: Shigar da kalmominka, a raba su da sarari
recoveryEntry.checksumFailed: Waɗannan kalmomi ba lambar dawowa ce mai inganci ba. Duba kuskuren rubutu.

unlock.title: Buɗe littattafan sirri
unlock.noKeyring: An ɓoye littattafanka na sirri a wannan na'ura da maɓallin da babu shi yanzu, kuma ba a saita kalmar sirri ba, don haka ba za a iya buɗe su ba.
unlock.bodyJoin: Ka kunna daidaitawa mai ɓoyewa a wata na'ura. Shigar da waccan kalmar sirri don kawo littattafanka nan.
unlock.body: Shigar da kalmar sirrinka don buɗe littattafanka na sirri a wannan na'ura.
unlock.recoveryBody: Shigar da lambar dawowa da ka rubuta.
unlock.newPassphraseBody: An buɗe. Zaɓi sabuwar kalmar sirri domin ka buɗe sauran na'urori ba tare da lambar dawowa ba.
unlock.useRecoveryCode: Yi amfani da lambar dawowa maimakon haka
unlock.usePassphrase: Yi amfani da kalmar sirri maimakon haka
unlock.startFreshBody: Wannan zai goge littattafan sirri da ke wannan na'ura har abada. Kwafin gajimare zai kasance a ɓoye kuma ba za a buɗe shi ba sai da kalmar sirri ko lambar dawowa.
unlock.keyUnavailable: Ma'ajiyar tsaro ta na'urarka a kulle take yanzu, don haka ba za a iya buɗe littattafan sirrinka ba. Babu abin da ya ɓace. Buɗe na'urarka ka sake gwadawa.

sync.title: Daidaita littattafan sirri
sync.body: Muhasaba, rajistar bashi, wasiyya da lambobin 'yan uwa ana ajiye su ne a wannan na'ura kawai, a ɓoye. Kana iya zaɓar adana su a gajimare tare da ɓoyewa daga ƙarshe zuwa ƙarshe.
sync.howItWorks: Kalmar sirrinka tana kulle su kafin su bar wannan na'ura. Muna adana bayanan da aka gauraya kawai, ba za mu iya karanta su ba.
sync.warningBody: Idan ka rasa kalmar sirri da lambar dawowa gaba ɗaya, kwafin gajimare ya tafi har abada — babu wanda zai iya buɗe shi, har da mu. Littattafanka a wannan na'ura za su ci gaba da aiki.
sync.paused: An dakatar da daidaitawa mai ɓoyewa ga wasu littattafai. Ba za a iya haɗa kwafi daga wata na'ura ba tukuna (yana buƙatar kalmar sirrin waccan na'urar, ko littafin ya cika). Bayananka a nan suna lafiya.

lock.title: Littattafan sirri
lock.subtitle: Shigar da PIN don buɗewa
lock.lockedBody: Shigar da PIN na manhaja don ganin su.

errors.corrupt: Waɗannan bayanai sun lalace kuma ba a iya buɗe su ba.
errors.wrongPassphrase: Kalmar sirrin ba daidai ba ce. Sake gwadawa.
errors.wrongRecoveryCode: Wannan lambar dawowa ba ta dace da wannan asusu ba.
errors.invalidRecoveryCode: Wannan ba lambar dawowa ce mai inganci ba. Duba kuskuren rubutu.
errors.locked: Littattafanka na sirri a kulle suke a wannan na'ura. Buɗe su da kalmar sirrinka.
errors.keyMismatch: An kulle waɗannan littattafai a wata na'ura. Shigar da kalmar sirrin da ka saita a can.
errors.noKeyring: Ba a saita daidaitawa mai ɓoyewa ba tukuna.
errors.unavailable: Ma'ajiya mai tsaro ba ta samuwa a wannan na'ura yanzu.
errors.tooLarge: Wannan littafi ya yi girma da yawa don ajiyewa. Cire wasu shigarwa ka sake gwadawa.
errors.keyUnavailable: Ba za a iya buɗe littattafan sirrinka ba yayin da na'urarka ke kulle. Buɗe na'urarka ka sake gwadawa.

settings.lockJournalsHint: Nemi PIN na manhaja kafin buɗe muhasaba, bashi, wasiyya da lambobin 'yan uwa
settings.newRecoveryCodeHint: Tsohuwar lambar dawowarka ba za ta ƙara aiki ba

fiqh.disclaimer: Game da yanayinka na kanka, tuntuɓi ƙwararren malami.

badge.schoolA11y: Hukuncin da aka nuna na mazhabar {{school}}
badge.customA11y: Ƙima ta musamman bisa shawarar malaminka

note.validViews: Dukkan mazhabobi huɗu matsayi ne da aka amince da su a ilimin Ahlus-Sunnah.

talfiq.title: Haɗa mazhabobi
talfiq.body: Ba a so a haɗa mazhabobi don neman sauƙi. Bi jagorancin malaminka.

picker.title: Mazhabata
picker.subtitle: Hukunce-hukunce a cikin manhajar gaba ɗaya suna bin mazhabar da ka zaɓa. Ana sanya wa bambance-bambance alama koyaushe, kuma sauran ra'ayoyi suna nan da taɓawa ɗaya.

desc.hanafi: Mazhabar Imam Abu Hanifa (rasu 150 BH). Ana bin ta sosai a Kudanci da Tsakiyar Asiya, Turkiyya da yankin Balkan.
desc.shafii: Mazhabar Imam al-Shafi'i (rasu 204 BH). Ana bin ta sosai a Kudu maso Gabashin Asiya, Gabashin Afirka, Yaman da wasu sassan Gabas ta Tsakiya.
desc.maliki: Mazhabar Imam Malik ɗan Anas (rasu 179 BH). Ana bin ta sosai a Arewaci da Yammacin Afirka.
desc.hanbali: Mazhabar Imam Ahmad ɗan Hanbal (rasu 241 BH). Ana bin ta sosai a Yankin Larabawa.

picker.allViewsDesc: Kada ka zaɓi mazhaba — duba matsayin kowace mazhaba gefe da gefe.

notSure.title: Ba ka da tabbas?
notSure.a11y: Ba ka san wacce za ka zaɓa ba? Nuna jagora
notSure.body: Bi abin da iyalinka, masallacin unguwarku ko malaminka suke bi. Dukkan mazhabobi huɗu hanyoyi ne ingantattu kuma sanannu na ilimin Ahlus-Sunnah. Idan ba ka da tabbas, zaɓi "Nuna dukkan ra'ayoyi" — za ka iya canza wannan a kowane lokaci a cikin Saituna.

start.title: Lokacin da La'asar ke shiga
start.hanafi: Idan inuwar abu ta kai ninki biyu na tsawonsa (tare da inuwarsa ta tsakar rana).
start.majority: Idan inuwar abu ta yi daidai da tsawonsa (tare da inuwarsa ta tsakar rana).

preferred.title: Lokacin da aka fi so na La'asar
preferred.hanafi: An fi son jinkirta ta, matuƙar rana ba ta yi rawaya ba.
preferred.majority: An fi son a yi ta da wuri a cikin lokacinta.

preferred.title: Lokacin da aka fi so na Asuba
preferred.hanafi: Isfar: bayan hasken alfijir ya bazu, ana barin lokacin sake sallar idan ya zama dole.
preferred.majority: Taghlis: da wuri, lokacin da har yanzu akwai duhu.

start.title: Lokacin da Isha ke shiga (don sani)
start.hanafi: Bayan farin shafaƙi ya ɓace (Abu Hanifa). Fatawoyi da yawa na Hanafiyya suna bin ɗalibansa biyu: bayan jan shafaƙi.

preferred.title: Lokacin da aka fi so na Isha
preferred.delay: An fi son jinkirta ta zuwa sulusin dare.
preferred.shafii: An fi son a yi ta da wuri (wani ra'ayi a cikin mazhabar ya fi son jinkirta ta).
preferred.maliki: An fi son a yi ta da wuri, musamman ga jam'i.
preferred.hanbali: An fi son jinkirta ta zuwa sulusin dare, idan hakan bai wahalar da wasu ba.

status.title: Hukuncin Witr
status.hanafi: Wajibi (dole): ƙasa da farilla, sama da sunnah.

form.title: Yadda ake sallar Witr
form.hanafi: Raka'a uku da sallama ɗaya; alƙunut kafin ruku'u a raka'a ta uku, duk shekara.
form.shafii: Aƙalla raka'a ɗaya, galibi uku (biyu, sannan ɗaya), mafi yawa goma sha ɗaya; alƙunut bayan ruku'u a rabin ƙarshe na Ramadan.
form.maliki: Raka'a ɗaya da ake yi bayan shafa'i na raka'a biyu daban; babu alƙunut a cikin Witr.
form.hanbali: Aƙalla raka'a ɗaya, galibi uku, mafi yawa goma sha ɗaya; alƙunut bayan ruku'u, duk shekara.

qaza.title: Ramako Witr da aka rasa
qaza.hanafi: Dole ne: ana rama Witr da aka rasa a matsayin qaza.
qaza.recommended: An so: yana da kyau a rama shi.
qaza.maliki: Ba a rama shi bayan an yi sallar Asuba.

raisingHands.title: Ɗaga hannaye a cikin sallah
raisingHands.shafii: A kabbarar harama, kafin ruku'u, lokacin ɗagowa daga ruku'u, da lokacin tashi zuwa raka'a ta uku.
raisingHands.maliki: Sai a kabbarar harama kaɗai (sanannen ra'ayin mazhabar).
raisingHands.hanbali: A kabbarar harama, kafin ruku'u, da lokacin ɗagowa daga ruku'u.

fatihaBehindImam.title: Karanta Fatiha a bayan liman
fatihaBehindImam.hanafi: Ba a karanta ta: mamu yana saurara, kuma karatun liman ya isa.
fatihaBehindImam.shafii: Wajibi ne ga mamu a kowace raka'a ta kowace sallah.
fatihaBehindImam.maliki: Ana karanta ta a sallolin asirce; a na bayyane mamu yana saurara.
fatihaBehindImam.hanbali: An so a sallolin asirce da lokacin tsayawar liman; in ba haka ba mamu yana saurara.

fajrQunut.title: Alƙunut a Asuba
fajrQunut.shafii: Sunnah: ana yin sa a tsaye bayan ruku'u a raka'a ta biyu.
fajrQunut.maliki: An so: ana yin sa a asirce kafin ruku'u a raka'a ta biyu.
fajrQunut.hanbali: Ba a yin sa, sai dai alƙunut a lokacin bala'i (nazila).

lastSitting.title: Yadda ake zama a tahiya ta ƙarshe
lastSitting.hanafi: Iftirashi (zama a kan ƙafar hagu, ƙafar dama a tsaye) a kowane zama, har da na ƙarshe.
lastSitting.shafii: Tawarruki (zama a ƙasa, ƙafar hagu ƙarƙashin ƙafar dama) a zama na ƙarshe na kowace sallah, har da sallah mai raka'a biyu; iftirashi a sauran.
lastSitting.maliki: Tawarruki a kowane zama, na farko da na ƙarshe.
lastSitting.hanbali: Tawarruki kawai a zama na ƙarshe na sallar da ke da tahiya biyu (raka'a uku ko huɗu); in ba haka ba iftirashi.

firstTashahhud.title: Hukuncin tahiya ta farko
firstTashahhud.wajib: Wajibi: idan aka manta, sujjadar rafkannuwa tana gyara sallah.
firstTashahhud.sunnah: Sunnah: idan aka manta, ana cike ta da sujjadar rafkannuwa.

abandoning.title: Hukuncin mai barin sallah
abandoning.majority: Babban zunubi mai girma; mutum yana nan Musulmi matuƙar bai musanta wajibcin sallah ba.
abandoning.hanbali: Ra'ayin da aka dogara da shi: wanda ya dage kan barinta bayan hukuma ta kira shi zuwa gare ta, ana hukunta shi da fita daga Musulunci.

minCongregation.title: Mafi ƙarancin jam'i na Juma'a
minCongregation.maliki: Maza goma sha biyu ban da liman.

sunnah.title: Sunnah kafin Juma'a da bayanta
sunnah.hanafi: Raka'a huɗu kafin da huɗu bayan, dukansu sunnah mu'akkada (Abu Yusuf: shida bayan — da yawa suna yin huɗu, sannan biyu).
sunnah.shafii: Kamar Azahar: raka'a biyu kafin da biyu bayan suna da ƙarfi; huɗu da huɗu suna cika ta.
sunnah.maliki: Babu sunnah tsayayyiya (ratiba) kafin ko bayan; nafila ta halatta.
sunnah.hanbali: Babu sunnah tsayayyiya kafin (nafila kafinta mustahabbi ce); bayanta, aƙalla raka'a biyu har zuwa shida.

status.title: Hukuncin sallar Idi
status.hanafi: Wajibi ne ga waɗanda dole su halarci Juma'a.
status.hanbali: Fardu kifaya (wajibi na al'umma gaba ɗaya).

extraTakbirs.title: Ƙarin kabbarori a sallar Idi
extraTakbirs.hanafi: Uku a kowace raka'a: kafin karatu a ta farko, bayansa a ta biyu.
extraTakbirs.shafii: Bakwai a raka'a ta farko da biyar a ta biyu, ban da kabbarar harama da kabbarar tashi.
extraTakbirs.sixFive: Shida a raka'a ta farko (bakwai idan an ƙirga kabbarar harama) da biyar a ta biyu.

fatiha.title: Fatiha a sallar jana'iza
fatiha.hanafi: Ba a karanta ta a matsayin karatu; yabon Allah yana bin kabbara ta farko.
fatiha.obligatory: Wajibi ne bayan kabbara ta farko.
fatiha.maliki: Ba a karanta ta; ana bin kabbarori da yabo da addu'a.

preset.title: Sunnonin rawatib na asali a manhajar
preset.hanafi: Raka'a 12: 2 kafin Asuba, 4 kafin da 2 bayan Azahar, 2 bayan Magariba, 2 bayan Isha.
preset.ten: Raka'a 10: 2 kafin Asuba, 2 kafin da 2 bayan Azahar, 2 bayan Magariba, 2 bayan Isha.
preset.maliki: Manhajar tana amfani da tsarin raka'a 10. Littattafan Malikiyya suna ƙarfafa sallar nafila a kusa da waɗannan lokuta ba tare da ƙayyade adadi ba.

fajrMakeup.title: Ramuwar sunnar Asuba
fajrMakeup.hanafi: Ana rama ta tare da Asuba da aka rasa, kafin zawali. Idan sunnar kaɗai aka rasa ba a rama ta (Abu Hanifa, Abu Yusuf); Muhammad ya halatta bayan fitowar rana har zuwa zawali.
fajrMakeup.recommended: Ana son a rama ta idan aka rasa, har bayan fitowar rana.
fajrMakeup.maliki: Ita kaɗai ce nafila da ake ramawa — bayan fitowar rana har zuwa zawali.

rakahs.title: Adadin raka'o'in Tarawihi (don sani)
rakahs.maliki: Ashirin; talatin da shida ita ce tsohuwar al'adar mutanen Madina.

takbir.title: Kabbarar Tashriƙ bayan sallolin farilla
takbir.hanafi: Wajibi, daga Asuba ta 9 zuwa La'asar ta 13 ga Zul-Hijja; tana farawa da kabbara biyu.
takbir.shafii: Sunnah, daga Asuba ta 9 zuwa La'asar ta 13 ga Zul-Hijja; tana farawa da kabbara uku.
takbir.maliki: Sunnah, daga Azahar ta 10 zuwa Asuba ta 13 ga Zul-Hijja; kabbara uku.
takbir.hanbali: Sunnah, daga Asuba ta 9 zuwa La'asar ta 13 ga Zul-Hijja; tana farawa da kabbara biyu.

min.title: Mafi ƙarancin lokacin haila
min.maliki: Babu mafi ƙaranci game da ibada: duk wani jini yana ƙirguwa.

max.title: Mafi tsawon lokacin haila
max.maliki: Kwana goma sha biyar. Mace mai al'ada tabbatacciya tana ƙara har kwana uku a kanta (istizhari), ba tare da wuce goma sha biyar ba.

minPurity.title: Mafi ƙarancin tsarki tsakanin haila biyu

beyondMax.title: Jinin da ya wuce mafi tsawon lokaci
beyondMax.hanafi: Istihala (jinin cuta): ta koma sallah, da sabon alwala ga kowane lokacin sallah.
beyondMax.habitColour: Istihala (jinin cuta): ana rarrabe kwanakin ta al'adarta ko ta launin jinin.
beyondMax.maliki: Istihala (jinin cuta): ta koma sallah (an so sabon alwala ga kowace sallah).

quranRecitation.title: Karatun Alkur'ani lokacin haila
quranRecitation.majority: Ba a karanta shi a matsayin Alkur'ani. Saurara ya halatta, kuma ana iya faɗin kalmomin Alkur'ani a matsayin zikiri ko addu'a.
quranRecitation.maliki: Tana iya karantawa daga haddarta; ba ta taɓa Mushafi.

max.title: Mafi tsawon lokacin jinin biki (nifasi, jini bayan haihuwa)

distance.title: Nisan taƙaita sallah (ƙasaru)
distance.hanafi: Kusan km 77–78 (mil 48): tafiyar kwana uku bisa ma'aunin da.
distance.majority: Kusan km 81–89 (burudi huɗu); fassarar tsohon ma'aunin ta bambanta.

status.title: Hukuncin taƙaitawa (ƙasaru) a tafiya
status.hanafi: Wajibi: matafiyi yana sallar raka'a biyu, ba huɗu ba.

residency.title: Lokacin da matafiyi ya zama mazauni
residency.hanafi: Idan ya yi niyyar zama kwana 15 ko fiye.
residency.shafii: Idan ya yi niyyar zama cikakkun kwana 4 ko fiye, ba tare da ƙirga ranar isowa da ta tashi ba.
residency.maliki: Idan ya yi niyyar zama cikakkun kwana 4 (kusan salloli 20) ko fiye.
residency.hanbali: Idan ya yi niyyar zama fiye da kwana 4 (fiye da salloli 20).

travel.title: Haɗa salloli (jam'i) a tafiya
travel.hanafi: Ba a halatta ba, sai dai a Arafa da Muzdalifa lokacin Hajji.
travel.allowed: An halatta: ta gabatarwa (taƙdim) ko ta jinkirtawa (ta'khir).
travel.maliki: An halatta da sharuɗɗa, musamman lokacin da ake kan hanya.

rain.title: Haɗa salloli saboda ruwan sama
rain.shafii: An halatta ga Azahar tare da La'asar da Magariba tare da Isha, ta gabatarwa, cikin jam'i.
rain.maghribIsha: An halatta ga Magariba tare da Isha.

rawatib.title: Sunnonin rawatib a tafiya
rawatib.hanafi: Zaɓi ne lokacin da ake kan hanya, sai dai sunnar Asuba; an so su idan an sauka.
rawatib.optional: Suna nan a matsayin sunnah; matafiyi yana iya barin su.
rawatib.hanbali: Matafiyi yana iya barin su, sai dai sunnar Asuba da Witr.

nisabBasis.title: Nisabin kuɗi da kayan kasuwanci
nisabBasis.hanafi: Wanda ya fi ƙarancin ƙima tsakanin zinariya da azurfa, domin ya fi amfani ga talakawa.
nisabBasis.contested: Zinariya ko azurfa. Game da kuɗin zamani, malaman wannan zamani sun saɓa; manhajar tana farawa da zinariya kuma tana ba ka damar canzawa.
nisabBasis.hanbali: Ƙimar da ta fi amfani ga talakawa: a aikace, mafi ƙaranci tsakanin zinariya da azurfa.

combineGoldSilver.title: Haɗa zinariya da azurfa don kai wa nisabi
combineGoldSilver.shafii: A'a: ana ƙirga kowane ƙarfe shi kaɗai.
combineGoldSilver.parts: I, gwargwadon kason da kowanne ya kai na nisabinsa.

jewellery.title: Zakkar kayan ado na mata na kansu
jewellery.hanafi: Zakka ta wajaba a kan kayan adon zinariya da azurfa.
jewellery.majority: Babu zakka a kan kayan ado halattattu da ake amfani da su yadda aka saba.

forgetfulEating.title: Ci ko sha da mantuwa yayin azumi
forgetfulEating.majority: Azumin yana nan ingantacce; ci gaba da azumi.
forgetfulEating.maliki: Azumin ya karye kuma ana rama shi (a azumin farilla); babu kaffara.

kaffarah.title: Abin da ke wajabta kaffara a Ramadan
kaffarah.eatingToo: Saduwa da gangan, ko ci ko sha da gangan.

afterMidShaban.title: Azumin nafila bayan rabin Sha'aban
afterMidShaban.shafii: Ba a halatta ba (ra'ayin da aka dogara da shi), sai dai idan al'ada ce, an haɗa shi da azumin kafin 15, qaza ne ko bakance.
afterMidShaban.noRule: Babu wani hani na musamman; ba a son azumtar kwana ɗaya ko biyu kafin Ramadan kai tsaye sai dai idan al'ada ce.

measure.title: Fidiya ga kowane azumin da aka rasa
measure.hanafi: Rabin sa'i na alkama, ko sa'i ɗaya na dabino ko sha'ir; an halatta a ba da ƙimarsa a kuɗi.
measure.shafii: Mudu ɗaya na abincin da aka fi ci a gari, a ba da shi a matsayin abinci.
measure.maliki: Mudu ɗaya na abincin da aka fi ci a gari, a ba da shi a matsayin abinci (ga tsofaffi sosai an so ne, ba wajibi ba).
measure.hanbali: Mudu ɗaya na alkama ko rabin sa'i na wani abinci, a ba da shi a matsayin abinci.

measure.title: Zakkar fid-da-kai ga kowane mutum
measure.hanafi: Rabin sa'i na alkama ko sa'i ɗaya na wasu abinci; an halatta a ba da ƙimarsa a kuɗi.
measure.majority: Sa'i ɗaya na abincin da aka fi ci a gari, a ba da shi a matsayin abinci.

wudu.title: Alwala don ɗawafi
wudu.hanafi: Wajibi: ɗawafi ba tare da alwala ba yana ƙirguwa amma yana buƙatar diyya.
wudu.majority: Sharaɗi ne: ɗawafi ba tare da alwala ba ba ya ƙirguwa.

status.title: Hukuncin layya (yankan Idi)
status.hanafi: Wajibi ne a kan mazaunin da ya mallaki nisabi; ana iya yanka ta har faɗuwar rana ta ranar 12.
status.shafii: Sunnah mu'akkada; ana iya yanka ta har faɗuwar rana ta ranar 13.
status.sunnah12: Sunnah mu'akkada; ana iya yanka ta har faɗuwar rana ta ranar 12.

hairNails.title: Yanke gashi da farce a kwanaki goma na farko (ga mai layya)
hairNails.hanbali: Ba a halatta ba (haramun) har sai an yanka dabbar.

grandfatherSiblings.title: Kaka tare da 'yan'uwa maza da mata (gado)
grandfatherSiblings.hanafi: Kaka yana kange 'yan'uwa shaƙiƙai da na uba, kamar uba (ra'ayin Abu Hanifa).
grandfatherSiblings.majority: Suna raba gado tare da shi (muƙasama); yana ɗaukar abin da ya fi masa: raba gado, sulusin saura, ko sudusi.

mushtarakah.title: Mas'alar tarayya (al-Mushtaraka)
mushtarakah.excluded: 'Yan'uwa maza shaƙiƙai ba sa samun komai idan kasonni ƙayyadaddu sun cinye gadon.
mushtarakah.share: 'Yan'uwa maza shaƙiƙai suna raba sulusin 'yan'uwan uwa daidai da su.

paternalGrandmother.title: Kakar wajen uba yayin da uba yake da rai
paternalGrandmother.hanbali: Duk da haka tana gado: ɗanta ba ya kange ta.

radd.title: Mayar da ragowa ga magada (raddi)
radd.heirs: Ragowar tana komawa ga magada masu kaso ƙayyadadde, ban da ma'aurata.
radd.treasury: A al'adance tana zuwa baitulmali; malaman baya suna mayar da ita ga magada inda babu baitulmali mai tsari.

malikiyyah.title: Kaka, 'yan'uwa na wajen uwa da ɗan'uwa na wajen uba (al-Malikiyya)
malikiyyah.hanafi: Kaka yana hana dukkan 'yan'uwa ko ta yaya, don haka yana ɗaukar sulusin da ya rage.
malikiyyah.zayd: Hanyar Zaid ta gaba ɗaya ce ke aiki: kaka da ɗan'uwa na wajen uba kowannensu yana ɗaukar sudusi.
malikiyyah.maliki: Kaka yana ɗaukar dukkan sulusin da ya rage; 'yan'uwa na wajen uba ba sa samun komai (al-Malikiyya).

intention.title: Niyya a cikin alwala
intention.hanafi: Sunnah: alwala ba tare da niyya ba tana ɗauke ƙaramin hadasi, amma lada yana bukatar niyya.
intention.majority: Dole: alwala ba tare da niyya ba ba ta inganta.

tartib.title: Jeranta (tartibi) wanke-wanke
tartib.sunnah: Sunnah: alwalar da aka yi ba bisa jerin Alƙur'ani ba har yanzu ta inganta.
tartib.fard: Farilla: dole ne a wanke gaɓoɓi bisa jerin Alƙur'ani.

muwalat.title: Ci gaba ba tare da tsayawa ba (muwalati) a alwala
muwalat.sunnah: Sunnah: tsayawa tsakanin wanke-wanke ba ya ɓata alwala.
muwalat.maliki: Farilla idan an tuna kuma ana iyawa: dogon tsayawa da gangan yana ɓata ta; na mantuwa an yafe.
muwalat.hanbali: Farilla: kada a bar gaɓa ta bushe kafin a wanke ta gaba, a yanayi na al'ada.

dalk.title: Cuɗa gaɓoɓi (dalki)
dalk.majority: Sunnah: ruwa ya gudana a kan gaɓa ya isa; cuɗawa mustahabbi ce.
dalk.maliki: Farilla: a shafa hannu tare da ruwa a kan kowace gaɓa da aka wanke.

touchOppositeSex.title: Taɓa jinsi kishiya
touchOppositeSex.shafii: Yana karya alwala: haɗuwar fata da fata tsakanin balagaggun namiji da mace waɗanda ba muharramai ba, ko babu sha'awa.
touchOppositeSex.desire: Yana karya alwala ne kawai idan akwai sha'awa, da gangan ko aka ji ta.

touchPrivateParts.title: Taɓa al'aura
touchPrivateParts.shafii: Yana karya alwala idan aka taɓa al'aurar gaba ko ta baya kai tsaye da tafin hannu ko cikin yatsu.
touchPrivateParts.maliki: Yana karya alwalar namiji idan ya taɓa al'aurarsa kai tsaye da tafin hannu ko cikin yatsu; game da mace, malaman mazhabar sun saɓa.
touchPrivateParts.hanbali: Yana karya alwala idan aka taɓa al'aura kai tsaye da hannu.

debtsToAllah.title: Zakka, fidiya da kaffara da ke kan mutum har ya rasu
debtsToAllah.third: Ana biyan su ne kawai idan mutum ya yi wasiyya da su, kuma daga sulusi (kashi ɗaya cikin uku).
debtsToAllah.capital: Ana biyan su daga dukan gado kafin wasiyya da rabon gado, kamar bashin mutane, ko an yi wasiyya da su ko ba a yi ba.

noHeirs.title: Wasiyya fiye da sulusi idan babu magaji ko ɗaya
noHeirs.whole: Ya halatta: idan babu magaji ko ɗaya, wasiyya na iya ɗaukar dukan gadon.
noHeirs.third: Har yanzu iyakarta sulusi; sauran yana zuwa baitulmali.

tahiyyat.title: Tahiyyat al-masjid a lokutan da aka ƙi da lokacin huɗuba
tahiyyat.notDislikedTimes: Sunnah ce, amma ba a yin ta a lokutan da aka ƙi sallar nafila (bayan Fajr da Asr, lokacin fitowar rana, tsakar rana da faɗuwar rana), ko bayan liman ya fara huɗubar Juma'a.
tahiyyat.shafii: Sunnah ce, kuma ana yin ta ko a lokutan da aka ƙi saboda tana da dalili (shiga masallaci). Lokacin huɗubar Juma'a, ana yin raka'o'i biyu gajeru.
tahiyyat.hanbali: Sunnah ce. Ra'ayin da aka dogara da shi shi ne kada a yi ta a lokutan da aka ƙi (wata ruwaya daga Imam Ahmad ta halatta); lokacin huɗubar Juma'a, ana yin raka'o'i biyu gajeru.

taqsir.title: Nawa namiji zai rage gashi (taqsir)
taqsir.hanafi: Aƙalla kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na kai dole a aske ko a rage.
taqsir.shafii: Aƙalla gashi uku na kai, aske ko rage, sun isa.
taqsir.wholeHead: Dukan kai: rage wani ɓangare kawai bai isa ba.

voluntaryFasting.title: Azumin nafila
voluntaryFasting.subtitle: Shirya, rubuta kuma ka kiyaye azumomin da aka so, ka kuma san ranakun da ba a yin azumi.
voluntaryFasting.searchKeywords: nafila sunnah azumi litinin alhamis arafah ashura tasu'a muharram shawwal shida fararen ranaku zul-hijja dawud sahur niyya qaza ramuwa

reason.eid: Ba a yarda a yi azumi a ranar Idi ba.
reason.tashriq: Ranakun Tashriƙ (11–13 ga Zul-Hijja) ranaku ne na ci, sha da ambaton Allah. Ba a yarda a yi azumi a cikinsu ba.
reason.ramadan: Wannan rana ce ta Ramadan. Ka rubuta ta a shafin Ramadan.
reason.dayOfDoubt: Ranar shakka (30 ga Sha'aban): malamai sun sha bamban. Da yawa suna ƙin yin azumi a cikinta, musamman don taka-tsantsan game da Ramadan. Azumin qaza ba laifi ba ne.
reason.beforeRamadan: Kada ka yi azumi kwana ɗaya ko biyu kafin Ramadan, sai dai idan azumi ne da ka saba yi akai-akai, kamar Litinin da Alhamis.
reason.fridayAlone: Malamai da yawa (mazhabobin Shafi'iyya da Hanbaliyya) suna ƙin keɓance ranar Juma'a ita kaɗai don azumin nafila; wasu kuma sun halatta. Ka haɗa ta da azumin Alhamis ko Asabar.
reason.pilgrimArafah: Ba a so ga mahajjaci da ke Arafah ba: Annabi ﷺ bai yi azumi a ranar ba a lokacin Hajjinsa.
reason.afterMidShabanShafii: Mazhabar Shafi'iyya: azumi bayan rabin Sha'aban bai halatta ba (ra'ayin da aka dogara da shi), sai dai idan al'adarka ce, an haɗa shi da kwanakin kafin 15 ga wata, azumin qaza ne ko bakance.
reason.afterMidShabanNote: Mazhabar Shafi'iyya ba ta halatta azumi bayan rabin Sha'aban ba tare da dalili ba; sauran mazhabobi ba su da wata ƙa'ida ta musamman.
reason.hayd: Babu azumi lokacin hayd (haila); ana rama kwanakin Ramadan da aka rasa daga baya.

block.eidTashriq: Ba za a iya rubuta wannan rana a matsayin azumi ba: ba a yarda a yi azumi a ranar Idi da ranakun Tashriƙ ba.
block.hayd: Azumi ba ya inganta lokacin hayd, don haka ba za a iya alamta wannan rana a matsayin an yi azumi ba. Babu laifi a cikin wannan; Allah ya ba da uzuri.

blocked.eid_tashriq: Ba za a iya rubuta wannan rana a matsayin azumi ba: ba a yarda a yi azumi a ranar Idi da ranakun Tashriƙ ba.
blocked.hayd: Azumi ba ya inganta lokacin hayd, don haka ba za a iya alamta wannan rana a matsayin an yi azumi ba.
blocked.ramadan: Ana rubuta ranakun Ramadan a shafin Ramadan.
blocked.nifas: Azumi bai inganta ba lokacin nifasi, don haka ba za a iya yi wa wannan rana alamar azumi ba.

excused.title: An dakatar da tunatarwa

excused.allowed: An dakatar da tunatarwar azumi yayin da kuke cikin uzuri. Har yanzu kuna iya rubuta azumi idan kun zaɓi yin sa.

short.body: Hailarki ta ƙarshe ta ɗauki kwana {{days}} — ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin mazhabarki na kwana {{min}} — don haka ƙila ba za a ƙidaya ta haila ba. Ki yi la'akari da ramuwar waɗannan salloli.

purity.body: Kwana {{days}} kawai na tsarki tun hailarki ta ƙarshe — ƙasa da mafi ƙarancin mazhabarki na {{min}}. Wannan jinin ƙila istihada ne; ki tambayi malami.
purity.bodyAllViews: Kwana {{days}} kawai na tsarki tun hailarki ta ƙarshe. Mazhabobi sun sa mafi ƙarancin tsarki tsakanin haila biyu kwana 13–15, don haka wannan jinin ƙila istihada ne; ki tambayi malami.

dhulHijjah.title: Zul-Hijja
dhulHijjah.searchKeywords: zul hijja kwanaki goma arfa kabbara tashrik tahlili tahmidi layya babbar sallah gashi farce
dhulHijjah.virtue: Babu wasu kyawawan ayyuka da Allah Ya fi so fiye da waɗanda aka yi a cikin waɗannan kwanaki goma. Ku yawaita zikiri: kabbara, tahlili da tahmidi.
dhulHijjah.offSeason: Kwanaki goma masu zuwa za su fara a {{date}}
dhulHijjah.teaserBody: Kwanaki goma na Zul-Hijja za su fara a {{date}}. Idan kuna niyyar layya, ku saita ta kafin su fara.
dhulHijjah.excusedBanner: Lokacin uzurinku yana kunne. Babu abin da ake hukuntawa a nan — ku yi abin da za ku iya, kuma zikiri da addu'a a buɗe suke koyaushe.
dhulHijjah.disclaimer: An yi wa hukunce-hukuncen da mazhabobi suka saɓa a kansu alama. Don halin da kuke ciki, ku tuntuɓi malami ƙwararre.

result.dhawuAlArham: Babu ko ɗaya daga cikin magadan da aka lissafa. Dukiyar ta koma ga dangi na nesa (zawul arham) — bisa Hanafiyya da Hanbaliyya, da kuma malaman Shafi'iyya da Malikiyya na baya — kuma yadda za a raba ta a tsakaninsu yana buƙatar malami.
result.tashih: Asalin da aka gyara {{base}} don kowane magaji ya sami cikakken rabo
result.radd: An mayar da ragowar ga magada (radd).

unallocated.spouse_only: {{fraction}} ya rage bayan rabon ma'aurata {{amount}}. Yana komawa ga dangi na nesa (zawul arham) idan akwai su; idan babu, malamai sun saɓa kan mayar da shi ga ma'aurata ko ga baitulmali. Ka nemi shawarar malami.
unallocated.treasury: {{fraction}} {{amount}} yana komawa baitulmali (baytul mal) a wannan saiti.

result.amountEachRange: {{amount}} ({{low}}–{{high}} kowanne, don kwabban su haɗu daidai)
result.debtsExceedEstate: Kuɗin jana'iza da basussuka ({{owed}}) sun fi gadon ({{gross}}), don haka babu abin da ya rage don wasiyya ko magada kuma ba a nuna adadi ba. Ɓangarorin har yanzu suna nuna yadda za a raba duk abin da ya rage bayan an biya basussuka.

special.umariyyatayn: Mas'alar Umariyya: idan akwai ma'aurata da iyaye biyu, uwa tana ɗaukar sulusin abin da ya rage bayan ma'aurata — haka yake a dukkan mazhabobi huɗu.
special.mushtarakah: Mas'alar Mushtaraka: mazhabobi sun saɓa kan ko 'yan'uwa shaƙiƙai maza za su yi tarayya a sulusin 'yan'uwa na wajen uwa.
special.akdariyyah: Mas'alar Akdariyya: ana haɗa rabon kaka da na 'yar'uwa a raba su 2:1.
special.malikiyyah: Al-Malikiyya: a mazhabar Maliki kaka yana ɗaukar dukkan sulusin da ya rage a nan.
special.shibhMalikiyyah: Shibhul Malikiyya: malaman Malikiyya sun saɓa a kan wannan al'amari. Sakamakon da aka nuna yana bin hanyar Zaid ta gaba ɗaya — ka nemi shawarar malami.
special.grandfatherSiblings: Kaka tare da 'yan'uwa maza ko mata: kaka yana ɗaukar mafi alheri daga cikin rabawa kamar ɗan'uwa, sulusin abin da ya rage, ko sudusi (hanyar Zaid ɗan Sabit).

why.sons_daughters_two_thirds: Idan babu ɗa ko 'ya, 'ya'yan ɗa mata suna raba {{fraction}}.
why.sons_daughter_sixth: Tare da 'ya mace ɗaya, 'ya'yan ɗa mata suna ɗaukar {{fraction}} don cika kashi biyu cikin uku (Bukhari 6736).
why.sister_half: 'Yar'uwa ɗaya ba tare da ɗan'uwa ba tana ɗaukar {{fraction}} (Alƙur'ani 4:176).
why.sisters_two_thirds: 'Yan'uwa mata biyu ko fiye suna raba {{fraction}} (Alƙur'ani 4:176).
why.paternal_sister_sixth: Tare da 'yar'uwa shaƙiƙa ɗaya, 'yan'uwa mata na wajen uba suna ɗaukar {{fraction}} don cika kashi biyu cikin uku.
why.maternal_sixth: Ɗan'uwa ko 'yar'uwa ɗaya na wajen uwa yana ɗaukar {{fraction}} (Alƙur'ani 4:12).
why.maternal_third: 'Yan'uwa na wajen uwa suna raba {{fraction}} daidai-wa-daida, maza da mata ɗaya ne (Alƙur'ani 4:12).
why.residuary_self: Asaba: yana ɗaukar abin da ya rage bayan kayyadajjun rabo (Bukhari 6732).
why.residuary_with_male: Yana raba saura tare da {{by}}, namiji yana ɗaukar ninki biyu na rabon mace (Alƙur'ani 4:11, 4:176).
why.residuary_with_daughters: Tare da {{by}}, 'yar'uwa tana ɗaukar abin da ya rage (Bukhari 6736).
why.awl: Kayyadajjun rabo sun wuce dukiyar, don haka an rage kowane rabo daidai gwargwado (awl).
why.radd: An mayar da ragowar ga magada masu kayyadajjen rabo daidai gwargwado (radd); ba a haɗa ma'aurata ba.
why.umariyyatayn: Wannan ɗaya ce daga cikin mas'aloli biyu na Umariyya da Umar ɗan Khaddabi ya yanke hukuncinsu.
why.mushtarakah_share: Mushtaraka: yana raba sulusin 'yan'uwa na wajen uwa daidai-wa-daida tare da {{by}} (Shafi'iyya, Malikiyya).
why.mushtarakah_excluded: Mushtaraka: kayyadajjun rabo sun cinye dukkan dukiyar, don haka 'yan'uwa shaƙiƙai ba sa samun komai (Hanafiyya, Hanbaliyya).
why.akdariyyah: Akdariyya: ana haɗa kayyadajjen rabo ({{fraction}}) da {{by}} a raba 2:1.
why.malikiyyah: Al-Malikiyya (Malikiyya): kaka yana ɗaukar dukkan sulusin da ya rage.
why.muqasamah_share: Kaka yana rabawa tare da 'yan'uwa kamar ɗan'uwa — mafi alheri daga cikin zaɓuɓɓukansa ({{fraction}}).
why.muqasamah_third: Kaka yana ɗaukar sulusi (na abin da ya rage bayan kayyadajjun rabo) — ya fi masa alheri fiye da rabawa ({{fraction}}).
why.muqasamah_sixth: Kaka yana ɗaukar sudusin dukiyar, mafi ƙarancin rabonsa ({{fraction}}).
why.muqasamah_siblings: Yana rabawa tare da kaka bisa hanyar Zaid ɗan Sabit (muƙasama).
why.muaddah_counted: An ƙirga shi a kan kaka, sannan {{by}} suka ɗauki kason (mu'adda).
why.muaddah_reclaim: 'Yan'uwa mata shaƙiƙai suna karɓar abin da zai cika kayyadajjen rabonsu ({{fraction}}) daga kason 'yan'uwa (mu'adda).

umrahMode.title: Yanayin Umara
umrahMode.subtitle: Abokin rakiya kai tsaye, mataki-mataki, don Umararka
umrahMode.searchKeywords: umara umrah yanayi jagora kai tsaye dawafi tawaf ƙidaya sa'ayi sai miƙati miqat faɗakarwa harami ihram talbiya aske halq taqsir zamzam
umrahMode.tvNote: Yanayin Umara yana ƙirga dawafi da sa'ayi kuma yana duba miƙati a wayarka. Ga tsarin matakan.

intro.title: Umararka, mataki-mataki
intro.body: Bi kowane aiki bisa tsari: miƙati, harami da talbiya, dawafi tare da ma'aunin zagaye 7, raka'a biyu, Zamzam, sa'ayi tare da ma'aunin tafiya 7, sannan aske kai ko rage gashi. Ana adana inda ka tsaya, don haka za ka iya rufe manhajar ka ci gaba daga inda ka bari.
intro.offline: Yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba. Addu'o'i sun fito ne daga Hisnul Muslim, kuma an yi wa hukunce-hukuncen da mazhabobi suka saɓa a kansu alama.
intro.completed: Umarorin da aka kammala da Yanayin Umara: {{number}}

umrahMode.endMessage: Za a share matakinka na yanzu da ƙididdigarka. Jerin ayyukan Umararka ba zai shafu ba.
umrahMode.readGuide: Karanta wannan mataki a cikin jagora

nextBlocked.tawaf: Ƙirga dukkan zagaye bakwai don ci gaba.
nextBlocked.sai: Ƙirga dukkan tafiye-tafiye bakwai don ci gaba.
nextBlocked.locked: Wannan mataki yana jira har sai an samu tsarki.

prepare.title: Shiri
prepare.body: Shirya kayan harami da muhimman abubuwa, koyi abubuwan da aka haramta a cikin harami, kuma ka tsara inda za ka wuce miƙati.

miqat.title: Miƙati
miqat.body: Kada ka wuce miƙati zuwa Makka ba tare da ka yi harami don Umara ba. Ta ƙasa, duba nisanka; ta jirgin sama, saita lokacin da jirginka zai ketare shi.

ihram.title: Shiga harami
ihram.body: A miƙati ko kafin shi: yi wanka (ghusl) idan za ka iya, sa tufafin harami, sannan ka yi niyyar Umara. Abubuwan da aka haramta a harami sun fara daga yanzu.

talbiyah.title: Talbiya
talbiyah.body: Fara talbiya da zarar ka shiga harami kuma ka yawaita maimaita ta har sai ka fara dawafi.

arrive_haram.title: Isowa Harami
arrive_haram.body: Shiga Masallacin Harami da addu'ar shiga masallaci, sannan ka nufi kusurwar Hajarul Aswad don fara dawafi.

tawaf.title: Dawafi
tawaf.body: Zagaye bakwai a kewayen Ka'aba, ka bar ta a hagunka, kana farawa kuma kana ƙarewa a layin Hajarul Aswad.

two_rakah_behind_maqam.title: Raka'a biyu a Maƙamu Ibrahim
two_rakah_behind_maqam.body: Bayan dawafi, yi sallar raka'a biyu a bayan Maƙamu Ibrahim idan akwai wuri, ko a ko'ina cikin masallaci idan cunkoso ya yi yawa.

zamzam.title: Zamzam
zamzam.body: Sha ruwan Zamzam idan za ka iya kuma ka yi addu'a. Aiki ne da aka so (mustahabbi), ba ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan Umara ba.

sai.title: Sa'ayi
sai.body: Tafiya bakwai tsakanin Safa da Marwa, farawa daga Safa. Daga Safa zuwa Marwa tafiya ɗaya ce, kuma za ka ƙare a Marwa. Maza suna sassarfa tsakanin alamomin kore.

halq_taqsir.title: Aske kai ko rage gashi
halq_taqsir.body: Fita daga harami ta hanyar aske gashi ko rage shi. Da wannan Umararka ta cika.

complete.title: An kammala Umara
complete.body: Umararka ta cika. Allah Ya karɓa daga gare ka.

prepare.intention: Ana yin niyyar Umara a zuciya lokacin shiga harami, sannan talbiya ta biyo baya.
prepare.prohibitions: Abubuwan da aka haramta a harami

miqat.approaching: Kana gab da miƙati: {{name}}, kimanin {{distance}} km. Ka kasance cikin harami kafin ka wuce shi.
miqat.denied: An kashe izinin wuri. Kunna shi don duba nisanka, ko ka bi jagoran ƙungiyarka.
miqat.unavailable: Ba a samu wurinka a yanzu ba. Sake gwadawa a fili, ko ka bi jagoran ƙungiyarka.
miqat.landHint: Ana duba wurinka a kan wannan na'ura kaɗai, yayin da wannan allon yake buɗe. Ba a adana shi ko aika shi ba.
miqat.flightCountdown: Kimanin minti {{minutes}} kafin jirginka ya ketare miƙati ({{time}}).
miqat.flightNow: Jirginka yana daidai da miƙati kusan yanzu. Ka kasance cikin harami kafin ka wuce shi.
miqat.flightHint: GPS ba shi da tabbas a cikin jirgi. Kamfanonin jirgi da yawa suna sanar da miƙati, kuma mahajjata da yawa suna shiga harami kafin hawa jirgi.

counter.timerHint: Na zaɓi: yana nuna tsawon lokacin da kowane zagaye ya ɗauka.

direction.safa_to_marwah: Tafiya ta gaba: daga Safa zuwa Marwa
direction.marwah_to_safa: Tafiya ta gaba: daga Marwa zuwa Safa

sai.startHint: Fara daga Safa. Duk lokacin da ka isa Marwa ko Safa, taɓa don ƙirga tafiyar da ka gama yanzu.
sai.purityNote: Ana son alwala don sa'ayi, amma ba sharaɗi ba ne na sa'ayi bisa matsayar da aka dogara da ita a mazhabobi huɗu.

tawaf.startHint: Fara daga layin Hajarul Aswad: fuskanci Hajarul Aswad da kabbarar da ke ƙasa, ka bar Ka'aba a hagunka, kuma ka taɓa a ƙarshen kowane zagaye.
tawaf.noFixedDua: Babu ƙayyadaddiyar addu'a ga kowane zagaye. Yi addu'a da kalmominka da harshenka, karanta Alƙur'ani kuma ka ambaci Allah. An ruwaito ambato biyu a cikin Sunnah: kabbara a Hajarul Aswad, da addu'ar da ke tsakanin Rukunul Yamani da Hajarul Aswad a ƙasa.
tawaf.doubtTitle: Ba ka da tabbas kan yawan zagaye?
tawaf.doubtBody: Idan ba ka da tabbas, ka gina a kan mafi ƙarancin adadi, wanda kake da tabbas a kai, ka cika sauran. Shakkar da ta zo bayan ka gama ba a aiki da ita.

lock.tawaf_purity: Dawafi yana jira har sai jinin haila ko na biƙi ya ɗauke kuma kin yi wanka (ghusl). Haraminki yana nan daram.
lock.salah_purity: Raka'a biyun suna zuwa bayan dawafi kuma suna jira har sai an samu tsarki.
lock.sai_after_tawaf: A Umara, sa'ayi yana zuwa bayan dawafi, don haka yana jira har sai an yi dawafi.
lock.wait: Ki zauna cikin harami kuma ki ci gaba da addu'a da ambaton Allah. Idan kin yi tsarki, ki yi wanka (ghusl) ki ci gaba da dawafi. Idan ƙungiyarki za ta tafi kafin lokacin, ki tambayi malami game da halinki.

halq.menBody: Aske kai shi ne mafi falala: Annabi ﷺ ya yi addu'a sau uku ga masu aske kai, sannan ga masu rage gashi.
halq.womenBody: Mata ba sa aske kai. Ku tattara gashin ku rage shi kimanin tsawon ƙarshen yatsa.

complete.title: An kammala Umara — barka da warhaka
complete.subtitle: Allah Ya karɓi Umararka
complete.body: Umararka ta cika kuma an ɗauke abubuwan da aka haramta a harami. Allah Ya karɓa daga gare ka.
complete.duaBody: Babu ƙayyadaddiyar addu'a ga wannan lokaci. Gode wa Allah kuma ka roƙe Shi duk abin da kake so, da kowane harshe, don kanka, iyalinka da al'ummar Musulmi.

rawatib.enabledSub: Nuna sunnar kafin da bayan kowace Sallah a cikin mai bibiya.

stopped.silence: An dakatar da sauraro bayan ɗan shiru. Taɓa Ba tare da taɓawa don ci gaba.
stopped.background: Sauraro ya tsaya lokacin da ka bar manhajar.
stopped.interrupted: Sauraro ya tsaya saboda an buƙaci makirufo a wani wuri.
stopped.target: An cimma buri. Makirufo a kashe yake.
stopped.error: Ƙirga da murya ya tsaya. Kana iya ci gaba da taɓawa.

sheet.title: Ƙirga ba tare da taɓawa ba
sheet.howItWorks: Faɗi zikirin sai ma'aunin ya ƙirga. Sauraro yana faruwa ne a wannan na'urar kaɗai: ba a ɗaukar sauti, ba a ajiye shi, ba a aika shi.
sheet.lowVoice: Ƙaramar murya ta isa. Zikiri a ɓoye da ƙirga ta taɓawa duk ɗaya ne a kyau.
sheet.accuracy: Idan bai tabbata ba, ba ya ƙirgawa. Taɓa don ƙara wanda ya tsallake.
sheet.unsupported: Ƙirga ba tare da taɓawa ba babu a wannan na'urar.
sheet.modelReady: An shigar da mai sauraro a na'urar.
sheet.model: Yana buƙatar mai sauraro a na'ura (kimanin {{size}} MB), wanda ake rabawa da aikin Alƙur'ani. An fi so a yi amfani da Wi-Fi.
sheet.modelOther: Aikin Alƙur'ani yana amfani da wani mai sauraro a wannan na'urar. Wannan zai maye gurbinsa, kuma aikin yana aiki da kowanne.
sheet.downloadFailed: Saukewar ba ta kammala ba. Da fatan a sake gwadawa.
sheet.cellular: Ba ka kan Wi-Fi. A sauke da bayanan wayar hannu?
sheet.micExplain: Ana amfani da shi ne kawai lokacin da ma'aunin ke saurare, kuma a wannan na'urar kaɗai.
sheet.micDenied: An kashe izinin makirufo ga wannan manhaja.
sheet.pauseMode: Yana ƙirga kowane tsayawa — ba shi da daidaito sosai. Yana ƙirga kowace jimla da ka faɗa daban ba tare da duba kalmomi ba, don haka taɓa don gyara kuskuren ƙirga.

calibrate.title: Daidaita don muryata
calibrate.instructions: Faɗi {{phrase}} sau {{reps}} da saurinka da muryarka na yau da kullum. Saiti ɗaya kawai ake ajiyewa a wannan na'urar.
calibrate.done: An ajiye. An daidaita ƙirga da muryarka a wannan na'urar.
calibrate.failed: Ba a ji sosai a sarari ba. Sake gwadawa a wuri mafi shiru.

explain.body3: Zaɓin manhajojinka yana kan wannan wayar kuma ba a taɓa ɗora shi ba.

gate.title: Shiga don ci gaba
gate.body: Da'irorin iyali da abokin aiki suna buƙatar asusun da aka shiga, domin bayanan iyalinka su kasance tare da kai a kowace na'ura. Baƙi har yanzu za su iya shiga saukar rukuni.
gate.tv: Shiga a wayarka, sannan ka sake buɗe wannan allon.

hub.familyBody: Ƙara yaranka da laƙabi da shekarar haihuwa kawai, kuma ka taimaka musu su gina ɗabi'ar sallah da taurari da lambobin yabo.

privacy.title: Sirri tun daga tushe
privacy.body: Da'irori suna raba abu kaɗan gwargwadon iko: babu jerin gwanaye, babu matsayi kuma babu kwatanta tsakanin membobi. Kai kake zaɓar sunan nuni ga kowace da'ira; ba a taɓa nuna sunan asusunka da imel ɗinka ba.

join.badCode: Wannan hanyar haɗi ba ta ƙunshi lambar gayyata mai inganci ba. Nemi sabuwa.

join.forbidden: Ba za a iya amfani da wannan gayyata da wannan asusun ba.

roleHint.family: A matsayinka na memban iyali za ka iya ganin matsayin sallar farilla na yaranka. Ba a taɓa raba sallarka ba sai idan ka zaɓa.

partnerCircle.title: Abokin ƙarfafawa
partnerCircle.subtitle: Ku ƙarfafa juna a hankali — "an gama" kawai ake rabawa.
partnerCircle.gate: Da'irorin abokan aiki suna buƙatar asusun da aka shiga domin abokanka su sake samunka a kowace na'ura.
partnerCircle.intro: Zaɓi manufar yau da kullum ta sirri, sannan ka raba "an gama" a hankali da abokai 1–4. Babu maki, kashi ko matsayi — ɗigo kawai, addu'a da tunatarwa masu tausayi.
partnerCircle.haveInvite: Kana da lambar gayyata? Shiga da'ira
partnerCircle.loadError: Ba a iya lodo wannan da'irar ba. Duba haɗinka ka sake gwadawa.
partnerCircle.waitingForPartner: Gayyaci abokin aiki a ƙasa — da'irar tana rayuwa da zarar wani ya shiga.

create.title: Fara da'irar abokan aiki
create.body: Da'irar abokan aiki tana da mutane 2–5 da ke shiga ta gayyata. Kowannenku yana ajiye manufarsa a sirri.
create.error: Ba a iya ƙirƙirar da'irar ba. Da fatan a sake gwadawa.

goal.title: Manufata ta yau da kullum
goal.private: Sirri — yana zama a wannan na'urar kuma ba a taɓa raba shi ba

today.title: Yau
today.shareHint: Yana raba "an gama" na yau kawai — ba menene manufarka ba.
today.shared: An raba "an gama" na yau. Allah Ya karɓa.
today.notShared: Ba a raba komai ba tukuna yau. Rabawa koyaushe na zaɓi ne — za ka iya tsallake kowace rana.
today.looksMet: An rubuta dukan Sallolin farilla biyar — raba "an gama" idan kana so.
today.excusedNote: Kana cikin lokacin uzuri — babu abin da ake tsammani. Raba kawai idan kana so.
today.pausedNote: An dakatar da rabawa. Abokan aikinka suna ganin "babu alama" a gare ka.
today.error: Hakan bai yi nasara ba. Da fatan a sake gwadawa.

dots.title: Wannan mako
dots.subtitle: Yau da kwanaki 6 da suka gabata
dots.legend: Ɗigo mai cike yana nufin "an gama". Ɗigo mara komai "babu alama" ne kawai — yana iya nufin ranar sirri, ta uzuri ko wadda aka tsallake, ba "an rasa" ba.

nudge.makeDuaHint: Yi musu addu'a yanzu; za su ga "Wani ya yi maka addu'a" ba tare da sunanka ba.
nudge.remindHint: Yana aika tunatarwa ɗaya mai tausayi da aka tsara. Suna ganinta ne bayan lokacin Isha nasu kawai, ba tare da sunanka ba.
nudge.duaSent: Allah Ya karɓi addu'arka. Za su san cewa wani ya yi musu addu'a.
nudge.alreadyDua: Ka riga ka sanar da su game da addu'a yau. Ci gaba da yi musu addu'a — za ka iya sake gaya musu gobe.
nudge.alreadyReminder: Ka riga ka aika tunatarwa a hankali yau. Ɗaya a rana ya isa — sake gwadawa gobe.
nudge.offline: Ba ka kan layi. Da fatan a sake gwadawa idan ka haɗu.

received.title: Gare ka
received.duaToday: Wani ya yi maka addu'a yau.
received.duaWeek: Wani ya yi maka addu'a a wannan mako.
received.reminder: Tunatarwa a hankali daga da'irarka: har yanzu akwai lokaci a daren nan. Allah Ya sauƙaƙa maka.
received.returnDua: Za ka iya mayar da alherin da addu'a ga da'irarka.

invite.title: Gayyaci abokin aiki
invite.hint: Da'irar abokan aiki tana ɗaukar mutane har 5. Kowace gayyata tana aiki sau ɗaya kuma tana ƙarewa cikin kwanaki 7.

privacy.title: Abin da abokan aikinka za su iya gani
privacy.body: Ɗigon "an gama" kawai na kwanakin da ka zaɓi rabawa, da sunan da ka zaɓa don wannan da'irar. Ba a taɓa aika manufarka, rikodin Sallarka, bayanai da qaza ba. Addu'o'i da tunatarwa ba su da suna, kuma babu maki, kashi ko jerin gwanaye.

evidence.title: Me yasa za a yi wa juna addu'a
evidence.intro: Annabi ﷺ ya koyar da cewa addu'ar da aka yi wa ɗan'uwa ko 'yar'uwa a bayan idonsu ana amsa ta, kuma mala'ika yana cewa: "kai ma kana da irinsa".
evidence.m2733: Addu'a ga ɗan'uwa Musulmi a bayan idonsa ana amsa ta (Sahih Muslim 2733)
evidence.m2732: Mala'ika yana cewa "kai ma kana da irinsa" (Sahih Muslim 2732)

privacy.body: Jadawalin sassa, sunan da ka zaɓa don wannan rukunin da jimillar rukunin. Babu ƙididdigar kowane mutum ko matsayi — kowane sashe da aka karanta don Allah ne.

intentionNote.body: Za ka iya rubuta niyya, kamar Ramadan ko wani masoyi da ya rasu. Malamai sun bambanta game da kyautar ladan karatu ga mamaci; manhajar ba ta ɗauki kowane gefe ba.

body.travel: Jerin kwanakinka yana nan lafiya. Ka yi tafiya lafiya — ladan abin da kake yi a gida yana ci gaba, in sha Allah. Ra'ayin mazhabarka game da taƙaita sallah yana cikin jagorar tafiya.
body.generic: Jerin kwanakinka yana nan lafiya. Huta, ka dawo duk lokacin da ka shirya.

personal_best.title: Sabon babban matsayinka
personal_best.body: Mafi tsawon jerin sallarka zuwa yanzu: kwanaki {{days}}. Alhamdulillah — abin da ka yi yana tare da kai.

body.fard: Sallah a kan lokaci a wannan mako: {{done}} cikin {{total}} — fiye da makonnin baya. Ka riƙe shi ƙarami kuma a tsaye.

quran_streak.title: Kusa da Alƙur'ani
quran_streak.body: Ka ba da lokaci ga Alƙur'ani a kwanaki {{done}} cikin 7. Allah Ya sanya shi haske gare ka.

body.one: Ka kiyaye “{{habit}}” kowace rana a wannan mako.
body.many: Ɗabi'un da ka kiyaye kowace rana a wannan mako: {{done}}.

adhkar_steady.title: Tunawa da Allah
adhkar_steady.body: Azkar na safe ko yamma a kwanaki {{done}} cikin 7. Kyakkyawar hanya ce ta fara da ƙare rana.

fasting_kept.title: Azumin nafila
fasting_kept.body: Azumin nafila da ka yi a wannan mako: {{done}}. Allah Ya karɓa daga gare ka.

muhasabah_steady.title: Yin lissafin kai
muhasabah_steady.body: Daren da ka tsaya don yin tunani a wannan mako: {{done}}.

showed_up.title: Ka bayyana
showed_up.body: Ka bi diddigin ibadarka a kwanaki {{done}} cikin 7. Kowane ƙaramin mataki yana da daraja.

body.noBedtime: Fajr a kan lokaci: kwanaki {{done}} cikin {{total}}, yayin da sauran sallolinka suka fi tsayawa. Yin barci da wuri kaɗan da karanta azkar kafin barci na iya taimakawa.

delayed_pattern.title: Sauƙaƙa {{prayer}}
delayed_pattern.body: {{prayer}} ta zo a makare fiye da yadda kake so a kwanaki {{done}} a wannan mako. Tunatarwa da wuri na iya taimakawa.

weekday_dip.title: Tsari don {{weekday}}
weekday_dip.body: Tsawon makonni uku, {{weekday}} ta kasance rana mafi wahala ga sallah a kan lokaci. Ƙaramin tsari don wannan rana — tunatarwa, ko sanin inda za ka yi sallah — zai iya sauƙaƙa ta.

family_ties_due.title: Zumunci
family_ties_due.body: Mahaifi ko mahaifiya za su so jin labarinka a wannan mako.

khatm_behind.title: Tsarin saukarka
khatm_behind.body: Tsarinka ya wuce karatunka da kusan kwanaki {{days}}. Tafiya a hankali ma tana kai wa sauka — za ka iya daidaita tsarin kowane lokaci.

body.pace: Qaza da ya rage: {{remaining}}. A saurinka na yanzu za ka gama kusan {{date}} — ƙarin ɗaya a rana zai kawo shi kusan kwanaki {{sooner}} da wuri.
body.start: Qaza da ya rage: {{remaining}}. Ko ɗaya a rana yana taruwa — rama su a hankali, kuma ka roƙi Allah gafara kan abin da aka rasa.

khushu_low_prayer.title: Halartar zuciya a {{prayer}}
khushu_low_prayer.body: Mayar da hankali a {{prayer}} ya fi wahala kwanan nan. Koyon ma'anar abin da kake karantawa na iya taimaka wa zuciya ta halarta.

rawatib_start.title: Mataki na gaba: sunnah
rawatib_start.body: Sallolin farillanka sun tsaya a wannan mako — Alhamdulillah. Kyakkyawan mataki na gaba shi ne raka'o'i biyu kafin Fajr.

jama_rate.title: Masallacinka
jama_rate.body: Shin sallah ɗaya a wannan mako za ta iya kasancewa cikin jam'i a masallacinka?

focus_emergency.title: Kullen mayar da hankalinka a wannan mako

graduation.body: Kusan shekara 13 yaronka zai iya komawa asusunsa. Balaga ita ce ainihin alama, don haka za ka iya ba da izini da wuri. Bayan sun koma, ba za ka ƙara ganin matsayinsu ba sai idan sun zaɓi rabawa.

timetableImport.reviewHint: Akwatunan da aka haskaka sun yi wuyar karantawa ko suna da ban mamaki ga wurinka. Gyara duk abin da ba daidai ba, ko share akwati don barin shi.
timetableImport.monthTitle: Wannan takarda ta wane wata ce?
timetableImport.outOfMonth: Wasu layuka sun wuce ƙarshen wannan wata kuma ba za a adana su ba. Duba watan.

timetableImport.fixInvalid_other: Lokuta {{count}} ba su kasance a tsarin HH:MM ba tukuna.
timetableImport.emptyBody: Ba mu iya samun sunayen Sallah da lokuta a wannan hoton ba. Gwada hoto mai kyau, kai tsaye na teburin kawai, ko rubuta lokutan.
timetableImport.errorTitle: Ba a iya karanta hoton ba
timetableImport.errorBody: Wani abu ya faru yayin karanta hoton. Sake gwadawa, ko rubuta lokutan.
timetableImport.intro: Shigo da lokutan iqama na {{name}} daga allon yau da kullum da aka buga ko takardar wata.
timetableImport.tips: Shimfiɗa takardar a kwance, cika firam da teburin, kuma ka guji haske mai ƙyalli. Yanke zuwa teburin idan za ka iya.
timetableImport.webDownload: A karon farko, burauzarka tana sauke kusan {{size}} MB na bayanan karanta rubutu daga jsDelivr (CDN na jama'a). Bayanan kawai ake saukewa — hotonka yana zama a wannan burauzar.
timetableImport.webCached: An riga an adana bayanan karanta rubutu a wannan burauzar.
timetableImport.keepPhoto: Ajiye hoton yayin da nake dubawa
timetableImport.keepPhotoHint: Yana nuna hoton kusa da lokutan. Ana goge shi idan ka adana ko ka fita.
timetableImport.cameraDenied: Samun damar kyamara a kashe yake. Kunna shi a Saituna, ko zaɓi hoto maimakon haka.

quranPronunciation.title: Duba furuci
quranPronunciation.intro: Karanta ayar da ke kan allo da ƙarfi, sannan ka taɓa An gama. Kowace kalma tana dawowa a matsayin A bayyane, Sake saurare ko Ban tabbata ba. Komai yana zama a na'urarka.
quranPronunciation.listening: Ana saurare… karanta a hankalinka, sannan ka taɓa An gama.
quranPronunciation.unavailable: Duba furuci ba ya samuwa a wannan na'urar.

calibrate.not-enough: Hakan bai isa don daidaitawa ba. Gwada aya mai ɗan tsayi.

tajweedCoaching.title: Yi aikin waɗannan sautuka
tajweedCoaching.intro: Gajeren tsari da aka gina daga aikin karatun Alƙur'ani naka. Yana zaɓar sautukan tajwidi da ke bayyana a ayoyin da kake aiki a kansu kuma yana amfani da kalmomi daga karatunka a matsayin misalai.
tajweedCoaching.honesty: Wannan tsari ba hukunci ba ne kan tajwidinka: ya fito ne daga kalmomin da mai saurare ya ce ka sake gwadawa, kuma manhajar ba za ta iya duba tajwidi a cikin aya ba. Atisayen sauti suna sauraron sauti ɗaya a kalma ɗaya, kuma inda aka auna cewa dubawar tana aiki kawai. Malami ƙwararre shi ne mafi kyawun jagora.
tajweedCoaching.tvReadOnly: Aiki yana buƙatar makirufo, don haka yana samuwa a wayarka, kwamfutar hannu ko kwamfuta. Har yanzu za ka iya karanta dokokin kuma ka saurari kalmomin a nan.
tajweedCoaching.summaryIntro: Daga ayoyin da ka yi aiki a kansu yanzu.
tajweedCoaching.privacy: Ana lissafa tsarinka a wannan na'urar. Sautin karatunka ba ya taɓa barin ta.
